name: inverter_air_water_heat_pump
title: Inverter air-to-water heat pump (Daikin Altherma type), heating mode
summary: Detailed steady-state model of an inverter-driven reversible air-to-water heat pump (Daikin Altherma type, 2007): inverter compressor with isentropic and isochoric compression stages, effectiveness heat exchangers, fan and pump characteristics, frost/ice correction. Heating-mode branch of the original two-mode (SUBPROGRAM) file, flattened per decision D10.

authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, file initials VLD)

verification.summary: Runnable variant (labels as literals), adapted: energy balances of compressor and cycle closed to 1e-9 W, COP_cp 1.79 < Carnot 4.84; vs the EES stored solution the consistent air side agrees (air flow 4776/4778 m3/h, fan 92.8/92.9 W, compressor eps_s 0.324/0.3245); EES's stored condenser state is self-inconsistent, so W_cp and COP are not comparable.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of HP_INVERTER_REV_VLD05092007_DAIKIN-ALTHERMA3.EES (226 of 492 values; condenser part inconsistent)
verification.notes: Adaptations 2026-11-01: (1) frost latent heat +M_ice*H_ice; (2) crankcase heater in the wall balance; (3) condenser eps-NTU on t_cd_water: with t_cd_mean_water (superheat zone weighted at the 177 C discharge) the balance has no root with condensation above the water temperature - the cause of all earlier stalls; (4) fan cubic limited to psi <= 0.30: second, non-physical root (psi 0.58, eta 0.99, 926 W) removed. Native file: every numeric block converges, then CS-GAP-USER-STRING-FUNC (warning$ = change$(...)). Solution found by decomposition (pressures imposed) and continuation on p_cd; the shipped .initials converge the variant in 8 iterations.
